short.en: The view and the arm together

t.zh: 这条河里的青蛙更灵活：可以从前一块石头跳过来，也可以从「↶ k」那块跳过来。没写 ↶ 的石头，只能从前一块来。
t.en: The frog in this river is more agile: it can jump on from the stone before, or from the stone marked “↶ k”. A stone with no ↶ can only be reached from the one before.

goal.zh: 算出青蛙从岸边跳到最后一块石头，一共有几种跳法。
goal.en: Work out how many different ways the frog can get from the bank to the last stone.

how.zh: 岸边算 1 种：已经站在那里了。
how.en: The bank counts as 1 way: the frog is already there.

say.zh: 青蛙也能从前一块跳来：前一块在视野里。
say.en: The frog can also come from the stone before, which is in the view.

say.zh: 长跳的来处要用伸缩臂去读。
say.en: Where the long jump comes from is read with the arm.

hints.zh: 最后一跳从哪来？前一块，或者伸缩臂够到的那块。两种都算上：加起来。
hints.en: Where does the last jump come from? The stone before, or the one the arm reaches. Count both: add them up.

hints.zh: 岸边算 1 种：放行闸放过一个 1。
hints.en: The bank counts as 1 way: let a 1 through a Pass gate.

body.zh: 和爬楼梯一样，只是「前 2 级」换成了伸缩臂读到的那一块。来路离得多远都行，结构不变。
body.en: It is climbing stairs, with “2 steps down” swapped for the stone the arm reads. A way in can be any distance away; the structure stays the same.
